result.summary: The page is largely well-formed. The main anomaly found is a '−100%' discount badge on the pizza restaurant card, which appears to be a data/content error since a 100% discount is almost certainly unintended. No other visual breakage was detected outside of the intentionally scrollable/clipped areas.

issues.description: A promotional badge on the pizza restaurant card reads '−100%', implying the entire order is free. This is very likely a data or formatting error (e.g., a delivery-fee waiver being rendered as a full-price discount), which could mislead users and cause complaints or abandoned orders.
issues.suggestion: Verify the promotion data source. If the offer is free delivery, display it as '€0 delivery' or 'Free delivery' like the other cards; otherwise correct the discount percentage value.
